The '''Shadda-Bi-Boran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Shadda (star)|Shadda]], which was orbited by six [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]. It was destroyed when Shadda transitioned from its [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] phase to a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] phase in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />
